name: Basics in bread
description:
Learn how to make easy but delicious breads & understand the basic fundamentals of bread making, from selecting the right flour to proofing and baking of bread. This workshop is perfect for someone with very little or no experience in baking. These varieties of breads are great options for your day-to-day baking.
- Soft rolls
- Ladi Pav
- Sandwich Loaf
- Burger Bun
- Grissini

name: Puff Pastry & Choux
description:
A session of classical french pastries – a showcasing of hand lamination, achieving a flakey, buttery puff pastry with sweet & savoury fillings. Pair that with the beauty of making, piping & baking choux buns & eclairs alongside flavours of creme patissiere.
Puff Pastry:
- Savoury puff
- Apple turnovers
Choux Pastry:
- Chocolate Profiteroles with chocolate pastry cream and Chocolate Namelaka
- Mango Eclair with mango pastry cream with Vanilla Namelaka

name: 2-day Christmas Baking
description:
Learn techniques and recipes for classic festive products in this fun filled two-day workshop, covering a wide range of Christmas goodies.
• Christmas Plum Cake
• Dundee Cake
• Plum Pudding
• Dresden Stollen
• Kugelhopf
• Florentine Bars
• Mince Pies
• Crinkle Cookie
• Kipferl Cookie
• Spiced Chocolate Truffles
• Yule Log
• Gingerbread Man
• Christmas Verrine
• Chocolate Mediants
• Inclusion Bars

name: Sweet Tarts & Pies
description:
With this worksop, dive into the details of creating delicious tarts and pies. Learn the techniques to perfect your ‘sablée’ dough, lining of the shells and tricks to making a lattice top!
- Banana Caramel Hazelnut Tart
- Dark Chocolate & Berry Tart
- Apple Ginger Cinnamon Pie
- Pecan Pie

name: Savoury Bakes
description:
Step into the ‘hot’ side of our kitchen where we’ll be making a variety of savory products like tarts, quiches and bagels, while also working with shortcrust pastry.
• Mushroom Thyme & Spinach Tart
• Oriental Chicken Tart
• Caramelized Onions & Feta Cheese Tart
• Calzone
• Jerusalem Bagels

name: Breakfast Pastries
description:
Learn the art of lamination, the beauty of having layers of butter & dough coming together to form flakey, buttery & scrumptious pastries with a variety of fillings & looks.
• Classic Croissant
• Chocolate Croissant
• Almond Croissant
• Almond Marzipan
• Cinnamon Roll (Cinnamon Roll Mix)
• Fruit Danish
• Almond Cream & Pastry Cream

name: Teatime Cakes
description:
Learn the recipes and techniques to take classic tea-time cakes to the next level, and discover ways to make these cakes travel well and last longer.
• Classic Lemon Tea Cake
• Devil’s Chocolate Cake
• Marble Cake
• Carrot Cake
• Banana Bread

name: Cupcakes, Cookies & Muffins
description:
A perfectly frosted cupcake fixes all our problems! This class takes you through the recipes and techniques to make decadent cupcakes, creamy frostings, fudgy cookies and more, all with the perfect texture.
• Chocolate Cupcake
• Red Velvet Cupcake
• Vanilla Caramel Cupcake
• Apple Oats Muffin
• Double Chocolate Chip Cookie
• Oatmeal Cranberry Cookie
• Lemon Crinkle Cookie

name: Baked Dessert
description:
This class helps you achieve perfect baked desserts every time, with recipes and techniques for silky custards & decadent puddings like a classic cheesecake, and an ooey-gooey crowd pleaser, the iconic choco lava cake!
• Classic New York Cheesecake
• Crème Caramel
• Bread & Butter Pudding
• Choco Lava Cake
• Crème Brûlée

name: Enriched Breads
description:
From the classic sugar glazed donut to the most extravagant brioche, this workshop focuses on the techniques to create enriched doughs, with a bunch of delicious fillings!
Donuts:
• Classic Glazed
• Cinnamon Sugar
• Coffee Cocoa

Berliners:
• Peanut Butter Jelly
• Vanilla Blueberry
• Berry Jam

Brioche:
• Brioche à Tête
• Mascarpone-filled Brioche

name: All About Cheesecakes
description:
Learn the art of baking the creamiest cheesecakes, recipes that are both bake & no-bake friendly, with classy & decadent toppings that add to both flavour and finish! 
• Basque Cheesecake
• No Bake Cheesecake (with Mango Passion Gel)
• Chocolate Cheesecake (Cherry confit, Chocolate Mandola cookie, Gourmand glaze, Dark Chocolate Whipped Namelaka)
• Eggless Caramel Pecan Cheesecake (Baked cheesecake, Graham cracker crust, Soft caramel, Caramel chantilly, Pecan praline)
